paragraphs: If your CLC 180 has the M271 1.8-litre supercharged petrol engine - fitted across the entire CL203 generation from 2008 to 2011 - timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues are a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by established Mercedes specialist consensus. We replace the timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.
include_in_hero_hook: yes - Source: established Mercedes specialist pattern (per G-BRF). Applies to M271 petrol variants. Excludes CLC 220 CDI diesel variants, which use a different engine family.
